levels.surface: مالك بن عبد الواحد أبو غسان

notes: «قرأت على الفضيل» is a reading transmission (the chain names Fudayl as the one read to), written as the chain's word order; the gloss-free name «معتمر» is kept as written.
The saying ends at the Companion «النعمان بن بشير» who reports hearing the Prophet.
